import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_safety_client


def moderate_batch(payloads, config=None):
    client = get_safety_client(config)
    results = []
    for payload in payloads:
        response = client.post("https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze",
            params={"key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY"]},
            json={"comment": {"text": payload["text"]}, "languages": ["en"],
                   "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}}, "doNotStore": True}, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        results.append({"toxicity": response.json()["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]})
    return results

import os

import requests


def moderation_summary(payloads, config=None):
    summary = {}
    for payload in payloads:
        response = requests.post("https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze",
            params={"key": config.get("api_key") or os.environ["PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY"]},
            json={"comment": {"text": payload["text"]}, "languages": ["en"],
                   "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}}, "doNotStore": True}, timeout=30)
        response.raise_for_status()
        toxicity_score = response.json()["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]
        summary[payload["text"]] = toxicity_score
    return summary

import os

import requests


def appeal_translate(text, target_language, config=None):
    client_id = config.get("client_id") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_TRANSLATE_CLIENT_ID"]
    client_secret = config.get("client_secret") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_TRANSLATE_CLIENT_SECRET"]
    response = requests.post("https://translation.googleapis.com/language/translate/v2",
        params={"q": text, "target": target_language},
        auth=(client_id, client_secret), timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["data"]["translations"][0]["translatedText"]

import os

import requests


def moderation_reason_embedding(text, config=None):
    client_id = config.get("client_id") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_EMBEDDING_CLIENT_ID"]
    client_secret = config.get("client_secret") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_EMBEDDING_CLIENT_SECRET"]
    response = requests.post("https://language.googleapis.com/v1/documents:analyzeSentiment",
        params={"document": {"content": text, "type": "PLAIN_TEXT"}},
        auth=(client_id, client_secret), timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["documentSentiment"]["score"]

import os

import requests


def reviewer_brief_audio(text, config=None):
    client_id = config.get("client_id") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_CLIENT_ID"]
    client_secret = config.get("client_secret") or os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_CLIENT_SECRET"]
    response = requests.post("https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize",
        params={"input": {"text": text}, "voice": {"languageCode": "en-US", "name": "en-US-Wavenet-D"},
                "audioConfig": {"audioEncoding": "MP3"}},
        auth=(client_id, client_secret), timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["audioContent"]
